summary: Galena is a shy Hearthian child found with Tephra on a Village porch. Galena participates in Tephra's hide-and-seek minigame using the Signalscope and radios; their dialogue appears in unusually small text reflecting their quietness.

behavior: Galena's dialogue is shown in smaller font size than other Hearthians.
location: Galena is found with Tephra on the front porch of a house in the Village on Timber Hearth.
Galena and Tephra each carry a radio for the hide-and-seek minigame.
mechanics: Galena is one of the children the protagonist hides from in Tephra's hide-and-seek minigame.
Galena's radio signal is detectable via the Signalscope on the Hide and Seek frequency.
